style_en: Japanese TV anime background art, crisp clean line art, cel-shaded, calm muted colors, slightly dim lighting, ancient Rome (Republic era), subtle washi paper texture. Same look in every picture.
avoid_en: text, letters, inscriptions, logos, modern buildings or clothes, nudity, blood

cuts.image: 古代ローマの広場の夕暮れ。石畳と列柱、奥に小さな四角い青銅の門の建物（両側に扉）。人はいない
cuts.image_en: An ancient Roman forum at dusk: stone pavement, columns, and in the distance a small rectangular bronze shrine with double doors on both ends (the Temple of Janus Geminus). Warm low sunlight. No people in the picture.
cuts.en: An ancient Roman forum at dusk: stone pavement, columns, and in the distance a small rectangular bronze shrine with double doors on both ends (the Temple of Janus Geminus). Warm low sunlight. No people in the picture.

cuts.image: 古代ローマの小さな青銅の門の建物。両開きの扉が大きく開け放たれ、遠くに出陣する軍の旗。夕方の赤い空
cuts.image_en: Close view of a small ancient Roman bronze shrine whose heavy double doors stand wide open; in the far distance, banners of a marching army under a red evening sky. No people in the picture.
cuts.en: Close view of a small ancient Roman bronze shrine whose heavy double doors stand wide open; in the far distance, banners of a marching army under a red evening sky. No people in the picture.

cuts.image: 古代ローマの小さな青銅の門の建物。両開きの扉がしっかり閉じられ、閂がかかっている。穏やかな朝の光、鳩
cuts.image_en: Close view of a small ancient Roman bronze shrine with its heavy double doors firmly shut and barred, calm morning light, a few doves on the steps. No people in the picture.
cuts.en: Close view of a small ancient Roman bronze shrine with its heavy double doors firmly shut and barred, calm morning light, a few doves on the steps. No people in the picture.

cuts.image: 古代ローマの家の中の机に、ナツメヤシ、干しイチジク、白い壺の蜂蜜、小さな銅貨が並ぶ。ランプの暖かい光
cuts.image_en: Inside an ancient Roman house, a wooden table with dates, wrinkled dried figs, a white jar of honey and a few small bronze coins, warm oil-lamp light. No people in the picture.
cuts.en: Inside an ancient Roman house, a wooden table with dates, wrinkled dried figs, a white jar of honey and a few small bronze coins, warm oil-lamp light. No people in the picture.

cuts.image: 古代ローマの書斎。机の上に巻物と蝋板と葦のペン、窓の外に夜の町。人はいない
cuts.image_en: An ancient Roman study at night: papyrus scrolls, a wax tablet and a reed pen on a desk, the city seen through a window. No people in the picture.
cuts.en: An ancient Roman study at night: papyrus scrolls, a wax tablet and a reed pen on a desk, the city seen through a window. No people in the picture.

cuts.image: 古代ローマの王（ひげの年配の男、白いトガに紫の縁）が、石の板に刻まれた暦の前で考えている。背景は神殿の中、灯明
cuts.image_en: An elderly bearded king of early Rome in a white toga with a purple border stands thinking in front of a large stone tablet carved with rows of calendar marks (no readable letters), inside a dim temple lit by oil lamps.
cuts.en: An elderly bearded king of early Rome in a white toga with a purple border stands thinking in front of a large stone tablet carved with rows of calendar marks (no readable letters), inside a dim temple lit by oil lamps.

cuts.image: 古代ローマの家の入口。木の扉が半分開き、外は明るい通り、内は暗い中庭。敷居に光の筋
cuts.image_en: The doorway of an ancient Roman house: a wooden door half open, a bright street outside and a dim atrium inside, a line of light across the threshold. No people in the picture.
cuts.en: The doorway of an ancient Roman house: a wooden door half open, a bright street outside and a dim atrium inside, a line of light across the threshold. No people in the picture.

cuts.image: 冬至のころの古代ローマの丘。冷たい朝、低い太陽がのぼり、松と石の家に霜
cuts.image_en: An ancient Roman hillside town at the winter solstice: a cold dawn, the low sun rising, frost on pine trees and stone houses. No people in the picture.
cuts.en: An ancient Roman hillside town at the winter solstice: a cold dawn, the low sun rising, frost on pine trees and stone houses. No people in the picture.
